title: Puzzle 2d Canvas Window Fit
description: Fix puzzle2d canvas not filling the window (left gap from stack body padding) and remove duplicate blue focus border on the canvas since the window chrome already shows active state.
summary: Puzzle 2d canvas now fills the window body (mode stack body drops padding when a puzzle2d canvas is present) and no longer shows a second blue focus ring—outline is suppressed on the canvas element and via attachCanvasListeners.
